title: Theory Of General Relativity
definition: Albert Einstein's geometric theory of gravitation published in 1915, which posits that the phenomena of gravitation is not a classical force, but rather a curvature of spacetime caused by mass and energy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (Science & Tech / Physics applications like GPS, gravitational waves, black holes) and Mains GS-3 (Space technology, scientific discoveries, applications of modern physics).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Theory Of General Relativity.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
